prompts: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one full-bleed 16:9 PRE-RENDERED GAMECUBE-ERA VIDEOGAME BACKGROUND. Art direction mandatory: look like an actual 2003-2005 Nintendo GameCube Pokémon Colosseum or XD environment render. Low polygon geometry with clear broad faces, modest smooth shading on simple models, flat/simple low-resolution baked diffuse textures, broad clean color areas, subdued vertex lighting, basic soft shadow blobs, simple plastic materials. This must look like a 2004 console game screenshot at 640x360 resolution enlarged cleanly, with limited early-2000s polygon budgets. NO modern cinematic realism, NO physically based materials, NO granular surface microdetail, NO photoreal texture, NO painterly brushwork, NO ray tracing, NO glossy raytraced reflections, NO depth of field, NO blur, NO film grain. Every surface simple and graphic. Reference image is COMPOSITION ONLY, change the rendering style completely to early GameCube. NO text, NO logos, NO UI, NO menu, NO border or bars. Preserve the reference's broad layout: Charizard sitting in LEFT foreground looking over ocean, Venusaur sitting in RIGHT foreground, simple low-poly seaside rocks and a small coastal town, lighthouse high on far left, sun just above ocean at sunset, orange-pink sky filling upper half. Characters must use simple nostalgic low-poly 3D game models with flat orange/blue-green colors, no textured skin. Simplify every rock to broad polygon faces, houses to colored blocks, ocean to basic plane with a few broad wave textures, sky simple gradient and flat cloud bands. Large open upper-center sky for separate logo. Warm welcoming palette; exactly a pre-rendered opening scene in a Pokémon GameCube game.
